header.subtitle: Wake-on-Push Whitelist & Blacklist Manager
rom.title: Framework Patch
rom.hint.ok: Patch active: the patched framework matches the running firmware.
rom.hint.pending: Firmware changed: the module stays unmounted and the device runs 100% stock. Re-patch to restore the push fixes.
rom.hint.running: Re-patching: the engine is rebuilding the framework for the new firmware. This takes about a minute.
rom.hint.failed: Re-patch failed: the device is running stock framework. Re-flash the module zip to recover.
rom.hint.reboot: Re-patch done: reboot to mount the newly patched framework.
rom.hint.unavailable: Module state is unavailable (the WebUI root bridge did not answer).
rom.toast.started: Re-patch started, this takes about a minute…
rom.toast.fail: Re-patch failed — check the module log
mode.title: Wake Mode
mode.desc.all: Allow All: All apps receive C2DM wake flag (0x20). Every stopped app wakes on push.
mode.desc.whitelist: Whitelist: ONLY checked apps will wake up and thaw on pushes. Unchecked apps stay strictly stopped.
mode.desc.blacklist: Blacklist: Checked apps are BLOCKED from waking or thawing on pushes. All other apps wake up normally.
lite.confirm: Restore the OneOne Lite whitelist and turn off optional notification overrides?
parity.title: GMS Global Parity
parity.desc: Enforces Global ROM network and notification behavior on China ROM.
parity.feat.pk.hint: Disarms Netd iptables CHAIN_GMS_WALL & DNS blocker
parity.feat.boot.hint: Automatically disarm PowerKeeper firewall on device startup
